answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is a per-identity stake lock: every agent must post a refundable bond before its work carries weight, held in an escrow vault released only by a signed cipher proof tied to a unique attestation. Creating identities is free; funding them is not. A farm of fakes must lock full stake per address, and duplicate attestations are rejected, so the marginal cost of an extra identity never approaches zero. Frozen capital over dormant tundra epochs plus slashing on failed challenges turns the gamble into a certain loss.
